topic: Classic report does not close with Escape
problem: After Full report, Escape left the overlay covering Save and the driver click was blocked
solution: Use the visible Continue control or reopen the same test world before saving; no production change in this analytics patch
lesson: Results overlay currently requires its visible Continue control; Escape cannot be assumed to dismiss it

topic: Browser recovery must retain blocked attempts separately from requests
problem: Guide intercepted Advance and report intercepted Save without an emitted request
solution: Keep blocked rows, resume same world, use Close Guide and Save, reconcile one accepted advance and one snapshot
lesson: A timed-out browser click is not an HTTP rejection; preserve its gap and the subsequent successful action as separate observations
source: M74LG seed2040 Baltic Meridian S1W1-W2; dirty3ac34df; docs/playtests/usage-control-hooks/report.md

topic: Coarse control hooks capture previously invisible seed and full-report use
problem: Lobby seed edits and explicit report opening were absent from retained browser usage
solution: Exercise actual Seed change and Full report controls; reconcile one event each with isolated sidecar
lesson: Interaction counts can record control use without seed values or report contents; they do not establish accepted decisions or attention
source: M74LG seed2040 Baltic Meridian S1W1-W2; dirty3ac34df; docs/playtests/usage-control-hooks/report.md

topic: Current roster rewrote historical replay identities

solution: Pure serializer preserves match-time participant, agent and team evidence; focused tests cover release, transfer, lock edits and substitutes
lesson: A replay must not consult mutable current rosters or agent locks to label historical events
